cohort: Women who delivered at more than 40 weeks gestation at a tertiary healthcare center in Kadapa, India between January 2021 and December 2022.
finding: The prevalence of meconium-stained amniotic fluid (MSAF) was 18.31% in women who delivered after 40 weeks gestation.
mod_finding: 88.7% of women with MSAF underwent cesarean section, while 5.1% had instrumental delivery.
